items.exampleEn: Loud music can damage your hearing.
items.exampleZh: 很大聲的音樂會傷害聽力。
每種疾病有不同的症狀。

items.exampleEn: Your genes decide the color of your eyes.
items.exampleZh: 基因決定你眼睛的顏色。

items.exampleEn: The new bus has space for people with disabilities.
items.exampleZh: 新公車有給身障人士的空間。

items.exampleEn: The dancer can move her hips very fast.
items.exampleZh: 那位舞者的臀部能動得很快。

items.exampleEn: The bus has special seats for pregnant women.
items.exampleZh: 公車有給孕婦坐的特別座位。

items.sentenceEn: The museum is free for people with disabilities.
items.sentenceZh: 身障人士參觀博物館免費。

items.audioEn: Our swimming class for pregnant women starts on Monday at ten.
items.audioZh: 我們的孕婦游泳課星期一十點開始。
items.questionZh: 孕婦游泳課什麼時候開始？

items.sentenceEn: Stretch your muscles before you run.
She hurt her hip when she fell on the ice.
items.sentenceZh: 她在冰上跌倒時傷到了髖部。

items.stemEn: A high fever is a common ____ of the flu.
items.stemZh: 高燒是流感常見的症狀。

items.stemEn: The doctors did ____ on his heart, and now he feels much better.
items.stemZh: 醫生為他的心臟動了手術，現在他覺得好多了。

items.passageEn: My grandfather is eighty, and he is very active. Last year, he had surgery on his hip after a fall. The first symptom was a pain when he walked. Now he does exercises to keep his muscles strong. His hearing is not very good, so we speak loudly to him. The doctor says his good health is partly in his genes. This spring, my aunt is pregnant, and Grandpa can't wait to meet the baby. The baby will be born this summer in another city, and Grandpa has already packed his luggage for the trip.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺八十歲了，而且很活躍。去年他跌倒後動了髖部手術。最早的症狀是走路會痛。現在他做運動讓肌肉保持強壯。他的聽力不太好，所以我們跟他說話很大聲。醫生說他身體好，一部分是來自基因。今年春天，我阿姨懷孕了，爺爺等不及要見寶寶。寶寶會在今年夏天於另一個城市出生，爺爺已經為這趟旅程把行李打包好了。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺去年為什麼動手術？
爺爺為什麼已經打包好行李？

referenceEn: My aunt is six months pregnant.
My aunt has been pregnant for six months.
rubricZh: pregnant 表示「懷孕的」，例如 six months pregnant、has been pregnant for… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在式、現在完成式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 muscle 造一個句子，說說你怎麼鍛鍊或使用肌肉。
referenceEn: I lift weights to make my arm muscles stronger.
My leg muscles hurt after a long hike.
rubricZh: muscle 表示「肌肉」，可數名詞，例如 arm muscles、leg muscles 等
說的是自己的經驗或習慣（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式、過去式等）
